verdict.rationale: Pomelo is a card-issuing platform, so a PCI-scope-reducing PAN/CVV reveal flow is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no hosted card-data component, secure iframe, or ephemeral-key reveal flow, and makes no claim about keeping integrators out of SAQ D. Wallet tokenization (Apple Pay/Google Pay) is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can show cardholders their own PAN and CVV without inheriting PCI scope — hosted components or ephemeral-key reveal flows the vendor documents as keeping me out of SAQ D
